items.title: 7-Zip Just Patched a Dangerous Flaw — Update Now
items.summary: A serious security hole (CVE-2026-14266) was disclosed in 7-Zip, the free file compressor. Opening a malicious .7z or a bad webpage could let an attacker run code on your PC. Fix: update 7-Zip to version 26.02 (Help → Check for Updates).

items.title: Stop the ads and trackers following you around the web — uBlock Origin is the free blocker that still works on Firefox and Brave
items.summary: uBlock Origin is a free, open-source content blocker that removes ads, trackers, and YouTube ads from your browsing. Install it free from the **Firefox Add-ons store (addons.mozilla.org)** or **Brave's extension library** — the full version runs great on both. (Chrome users get the limited "uBlock Origin Lite" because of Google's Manifest V3 changes, so Firefox or Brave is the move for the real thing.)

items.title: Tired of reusing passwords? KeePassXC is the free offline password manager that never touches the cloud
items.summary: KeePassXC is a free, open-source password manager that stores everything in one encrypted file on your own machine — no cloud account, no subscription, nothing leaving your PC. Download it free from **keepassxc.org/download** for Windows, Mac, or Linux.

items.title: Skip the monthly ChatGPT bill — Jan is the free desktop app that runs AI models on your PC with no internet and no account
items.summary: Jan is a free, open-source desktop app that downloads and runs AI language models entirely on your own PC — no cloud, no login, no subscription. Get it at **jan.ai** for Windows, Mac, or Linux.

items.title: Stop paying for WinZip — 7-Zip zips, unzips, and encrypts any archive for free
items.summary: 7-Zip is a free, open-source file archiver that opens ZIP, RAR, and 7z files and can password-protect them with strong AES-256 encryption. Download it free from **7-zip.org**.

items.title: Shrink that giant video file — HandBrake converts any clip to a smaller size for free
items.summary: HandBrake is a free, open-source video converter that shrinks MP4, MKV, and DVD files without losing noticeable quality. Download it free from **handbrake.fr**.

items.title: CISA Warns: Hackers Are Actively Exploiting On-Prem SharePoint — Patch Now
items.summary: CISA warned July 14 that attackers are actively exploiting flaws in on-premises Microsoft SharePoint Server — including CVE-2026-56164. Patch now and rotate machine keys; if you can't patch immediately, shut outside access until you can.

items.title: Lost laptop? BitLocker can be bypassed in minutes — install the July Windows Update to close the hole
items.summary: Turn on BitLocker (Settings > Privacy & Security > Device encryption) and install the July 2026 Windows Update at Settings > Windows Update > Check for updates.

items.title: Chrome's July 2026 update closes 382 security holes — update at chrome://settings/help
items.summary: Open Google Chrome and update it now: type chrome://settings/help in the address bar (or Menu > Settings > About Chrome) and let it download the latest build.

items.title: Turn any PDF or webpage into a study podcast free — Google NotebookLM at notebooklm.google.com
items.summary: Go to notebooklm.google.com with your Google account, drop in a PDF, Google Doc, or web link, and ask it to build an Audio Overview — free.

items.title: Florida storm season: an APC Back-UPS keeps your computer alive when the power goes out
items.summary: Put your PC on an APC Back-UPS (BE550G or BX series from apc.com or Amazon, or installed by ONYX SYSTEMS) to ride through blackouts and soak post-storm surges.

items.title: Stubborn app won’t go away? Revo Uninstaller Free deletes it and the traces
items.summary: Revo Uninstaller Free (revouninstaller.com/products/revo-uninstaller-free) removes stubborn programs and scrubs the leftover files and registry entries.
